blocks.label: P: Built around the individual student
P: Some students come because science has become confusing and they need help findi
blocks.text: Every student approaches science with different experiences, strengths and goals. Some need to rebuild foundations or regain confidence; others want to deepen their understanding, refine examination skills or pursue ambitious academic targets.

blocks.label: P: That might mean repairing a gap that has been causing problems fo
blocks.text: At Auxesis Education, I tailor one-to-one sessions to the individual learner. I identify what they understand, explore what is getting in the way and facilitate meaningful progress through questioning, guided practice and active engagement.

blocks.label: P: The curriculum tells us where the student needs to get to; the student helps det
blocks.text: My aim is to help students develop stronger scientific understanding, greater confidence and the ability to apply knowledge independently.

blocks.label: H2: Tutoring starts with a conversation rather than a commitment.
blocks.text: Tutoring starts with a conversation rather than a commitment.

blocks.label: P: Tell me what the student is studying, what is happening and where
blocks.text: Getting started begins with a conversation. I'll discuss the student's course, current challenges and goals with the parent before arranging a free Meet & Greet with the student and parent together. If everyone feels Auxesis is a good fit, we'll agree on the first steps and begin.

blocks.label: H2: More than 25 years in science education.
blocks.text: More than 25 years in science education.

blocks.label: P: I’m Amanda D’Souza, a science teacher and tutor with more than 25 years of exper
blocks.text: I’m Amanda D’Souza, a science teacher and tutor with more than 25 years of experience in Canada and international schools. I am an Ontario Certified Teacher, hold Qualified Teacher Status in England, and have worked as an IB Biology Assistant Examiner since 2013, with experience assessing HL Paper 2 and Internal Assessments against IB criteria. I bring that experience to tutoring, but the relationship is still personal: I want to know the learner, not just the course they are taking.
